name: Tai Kamiya & Matt Ishida
main_effect:
[On Play] You may return 1 Digimon card with [Greymon], [Garurumon] or [Omnimon] in its name from your trash to the hand. If this effect didn't return, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
[All Turns] When any of your Digimon are played or digivolve, by suspending this Tamer, gain 1 memory if you have a Digimon with [Greymon] in its name. Then, gain 1 memory if you have a Digimon with [Garurumon] in its name.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
